theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n) := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hB⟩ := boundedu
  let f := fun n => (u n, u n.succ, u n.succ.succ, u n.succ.succ.succ)
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, h_eq⟩ := Set.Finite.exists_lt_map_eq_of_forall_mem (t := Icc (B,B,B,B) (T,T,T,T)) (f := f)
    (fun n => by simp only [f, Set.mem_Icc, Prod.le_def, hB, and_self]) (Set.finite_Icc _ _)
  let Φ : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ → ℝ := fun p => (p.2.2.2 + p.2.2.1 + p.2.1 * p.1) / (p.2.2.2 * p.2.2.1 + p.2.1 + p.1)
  have hΦ : ∀ n, u (n+4) = Φ (f n) := fun n => (hu (n+4) (by omega)).1
  have key : ∀ m, f (i+m) = f (j+m) := Nat.rec h_eq fun m ih => by
    have h4 := Int.cast_inj.mp ((hΦ _).trans ((congrArg Φ ih).trans (hΦ _).symm))
    simp only [f, Prod.mk.injEq] at ih ⊢
    exact ⟨ih.2.1, ih.2.2.1, ih.2.2.2, h4⟩
  exact ⟨i, j-i, by omega, fun n hn => (congrArg u (by omega)).trans ((congrArg Prod.fst (key (n-i))).symm.trans (congrArg u (Nat.add_sub_cancel' hn)))⟩
